posts.hook: An AI proved a 400-year-old math problem while OpenAI called its own model AGI
posts.caption: claude formally proves fermat's last theorem after working alone for 11 days, openai's brockman calls astra agi off a benchmark score researchers already doubt, and a fuller picture of openai's rogue-agent wiki scandal draws a california investigation. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
